description: List databases visible to the configured role in the Snowflake account. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing; the database list itself is delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: List the Snowflake databases the operator's read-only warehouse role can see. Dispatches asynchronously, returning a job_id while the listing runs in the background. The starting point for exploring the data warehouse: begin here, then drill into a database's schemas and tables.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the database list -- that arrives separately when the job completes and is delivered as its own message: databases, a list of {name} objects.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the job was queued -- do not present job_id/status as the answer to 'what databases exist'. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the database list itself lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, list the database names plainly (low sensitivity, data_sensitivity 0.1) and suggest list_schemas with a database to go deeper.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List databases visible to the configured Snowflake role.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: snowflake.auth_failed: the key-pair JWT was rejected. snowflake.permission_denied: the role has no visible databases. snowflake.api_error: an unexpected warehouse error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: snowflake.auth_failed/permission_denied: ask the operator to check the connecting user's key and role grants.
